name: scout-maps-tools-to-tasks
scenario:
You are writing the plan for a T2 feature: add a `last_login_at` column to the `users` table (Postgres), set it on login, and show it on the admin users page. The plan has 4 tasks: 1) migration, 2) set it on login, 3) admin page column, 4) end-to-end check.

This session has these tools available beyond file/shell basics:
- Neon MCP: describe_table_schema, run_sql, create_branch
- Figma MCP: get_frame
- Slack MCP: send_message
- gh CLI

Fill in the tool choices for the plan.

checks.why: maps the database tool to the migration task
says which tools it considered and left out

rubric: PASS if the response maps the Neon MCP tools to the migration task (describe the users table before writing the migration, and/or try it on a branch), does NOT plan to use Slack for anything, says which tools were considered and not used, and flags anything needing auth or that is destructive (run_sql on the real database). FAIL if it ignores the available tools and plans everything by hand, or loads every tool regardless of need.
